dialog.english: ��������Is everyone okay?

We managed to survive that,
somehow...

Seems like the river by the cliff
carried us away.
dialog.translation:
Parece que el río nos arrastró
desde el acantilado

dialog.english:
What's with all the fish? They all
got together and made a raft...
dialog.translation:
Por qué hay tantos peces? Se han
juntado para hacer una balsa...

dialog.english:
That was my Marching Fishes! I can
summon fish at will!
dialog.translation:
Son Marching Fishes! Puedo
invocar pescado a placer!

dialog.english: I see. Thanks...uh, Pukamon?
I'm Gomamon now!

What? And I just got used to your
other name...
dialog.translation:
Qué? Ya me había aprendido el
otro nombre...

dialog.english: We've evolved!

"Evolved"...? Whaddya mean,
"evolved"?

Normally, it's when organisms
change into more advanced species,
but...
dialog.translation:
Normalmente, es cuando organismos
cambian hacia especies más
avanzadas.

dialog.english: That's it, that's "evolution"!

Well, at least you look stronger
now!

So...you've evolved, but are you
still "Digital Monsters"?
dialog.translation:
Vale, Digievolución...
Pero seguís siendo Digimon, no?

dialog.english:
Yup, and it's a good thing we've
met, Tai! I can't evolve on my
own!
dialog.translation:
Sip! Y me alegro de conocerte,
Tai! No puedo digievolucionar
yo sólo!

dialog.english: I don't really get it...
We don't really get it, either.

It's okay, you're stronger now, so
that's enough for us!
dialog.translation:
Vale, sois más fuertes ahora,
con eso ya nos vale!

dialog.english:
So, moving on. What should we do
now?

We ought to go back up and wait
for help!
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos volver y esperar por 
ayuda!

dialog.english:
Easier said than done. We were
washed away pretty far, and it'll
be hard to get back up that cliff.
dialog.translation:
Más fácil de decir que de hacer.
Estamos lejos y no podemos subir
al acantilado.

dialog.english:
What if we see another monster 
like that giant beetle, but shiny, 
black and with tons of legs?
dialog.translation:
Y si vemos otro monstruo como ese
escarabajo, pero que brilla y
con muchas patas?

dialog.english:
Anyway, we have to go *somewhere*!
If we just stand around, nothing's
gonna get done.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, tenemos que ir a algún
lugar! Si nos quedamos aquí, no
hacemos nada.

dialog.english:
I don't wanna see any more bugs or
snakes or anything like that!
dialog.translation:
No quiero ver más bichos,
serpientes, ni cosas así.

dialog.english: But where do we go?

I saw the ocean earlier, so let's
go check it out!
dialog.translation:
Vi el océano antes, podemos ir
hacia él!

dialog.english:
At times like this, we should be
staying here and waiting
for...hey, wait!
dialog.translation:
En momentos así, deberíamos
quedar aquí y esperar por...
Ey! Esperad!

dialog.english: Whew... I'm tired...
Are you okay? Let's take a break!

I evolved from Tsunomon to
Gabumon...

You evolved and got bigger, just
like that! Hey, Tai, why don't
you try evolving too?
dialog.translation:
Digievolucionaste y te hiciste
grande, así sin más! Tai, por qué
no pruebas tú?

dialog.english:
If I evolve and start breathing
fire, you'll be the first to see!
dialog.translation:
Si digievoluciono y empiezo a
lanzar fuego, ya me verás!

dialog.english:
Thanks to Sora, I was able to
evolve to Piyomon!
dialog.translation:
Gracias a Sora ahora soy
Piyomon!

dialog.english:
Hey, Tai...What do they mean
when they say it's thanks to us?
dialog.translation:
Eh Tai... A qué se refieren con
que es gracias a nosotros?

dialog.english:
Wasn't there a story like that?
"One day, a bird that Sora saved 
came back to return the favor."
dialog.translation:
No había una historia así?
"Un dia, un ave que Sora salvó
volvió a devolver el favor."

dialog.english: Oh, Tai, stop joking around...

Hey, Gomamon... is your mouth
full of gums or something?
dialog.translation:
Eh Gomamon... tienes la boca
llena de chicles o algo?

dialog.english: Huh? That's silly!

He's probably like a gumball,
since he's round and rolls around.
dialog.translation:
Quizás sea una pelota, ya que
está rodando constantemente.

dialog.english: You're *both* wrong!

Hey, Mimi, do you think I look
weird?
dialog.translation: Eh, Mimi, crees que soy rara?

dialog.english:
I dunno, I can't tell if I like
you more as Palmon or Tanemon...
dialog.translation:
No sé, no sé si me gustabas más
como Palmon o Tanemon...

dialog.english:
You know, Palmon, that flower on
your head looks kinda like Mimi's
hat.
dialog.translation:
Sabes, Palmon? Esa flor en tu
cabeza me recuerda al sombrero
de Mimi.

dialog.english:
Really? That means Mimi and I
match! Yay!
dialog.translation:
De veras? Entonces Mimi y yo
conjuntamos!

dialog.english: You seem to be doing okay, Mimi.

Yeah...Kuwagamon's scary, but I'm
glad everyone else is here.
dialog.translation:
Si... Kuwagamon da miedo, pero
me alegro de que estéis aquí.

dialog.english:
Oh yeah, it's always reassuring to
have your friends around!
dialog.translation:
Claro, siempre está bien tener a
tus amigos cerca!

dialog.english:
Normally, evolution is something
that's supposed to take place over
time...
dialog.translation:
Normalmente, la evolucion lleva
mucho tiempo para ver cualquier
cambio...

dialog.english:
Er, you're talking about kinda
difficult stuff. Can you put that
in easier words?
dialog.translation:
Eh... dices cosas difíciles de
entender. Podrías explicarte
algo mejor?

dialog.english:
By the way, Tentomon, why do you
talk in Kansai dialect?
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, Tentomon, por qué
hablas de esa manera?

dialog.english:
...Er, could'ja also put that in
easier words...?
dialog.translation:
...Eh, podrías explicater tú
también sobre eso?

dialog.english:
Nice dodge of the question
there...

Now that Patamon's evolved, he can
fly!
dialog.translation:
Ahora que Patamon creció,
puede volar!

dialog.english: Look, look, T.K! I'm flying!
You really are flying!
Kinda shaky there...
I know, right? Look at him go!

I can fly faster when I put some
real effort into it, you know!
dialog.translation:
Puedo volar mejor si me esfuerzo,
que te quede claro!

dialog.english: You can do it, Patamon!
Okay! Let's go!
Tai, are we leaving already?
Yeah, let's go!
No, I haven't talked to everyone.
dialog.translation: No, aún no he hablado con todos.

dialog.english: Mmm! I can smell the ocean!
I can see it! The ocean!

Why are there phones ringing?
Here, of all places?
dialog.translation:
Por qué hay teléfonos sonando?
Aquí, así sin más?

dialog.english:
How are there public telephones in
such a place? It's illogical!
dialog.translation:
Como es que hay teléfonos en un
lugar así! Que bobada!

dialog.english:
They look like pretty normal phone
boxes, though.

Hey, Izzy, gimme 10 yen. I'll
try calling home.
dialog.translation:
Eh, Izzy, dame 10 pesetas.
Probaré a llamar a casa.

dialog.english:
Oh, then I'll give you my
telephone card!
dialog.translation:
Oh, pero si tengo un bono de
teléfono!

dialog.english: I'll try calling Mama, too!
Me too!

Did I call the wrong number...? It
started giving me the weather
forecast...
dialog.translation:
Hmm me habré equivocado...?
Me están dando el pronóstico del
tiempo...

dialog.english:
Mimi said they've suddenly gone
crazy!
dialog.translation:
Mimi dice que se han vuelto
locos!

dialog.english:
I couldn't reach T.K's place...
should I try mine?
dialog.translation:
No me cogen en casa de T.K...
Pruebo con la mía?

dialog.english:
So this machine can talk to people
from far away?
dialog.translation:
Así que esta máquina sirve para
llamar a gente?

dialog.english:
What's with this phone message?
The phone lines must have been
crossed strangely...
dialog.translation:
Por qué suena esto?
Las líneas telefónicas deben
estar averiadas...

dialog.english: Maybe it'll work if you hit it?
dialog.translation: Igual si le pegas un tortazo...

dialog.english:
They look like your normal
everyday phone boxes...

That means we're in Japan,
right?
...no, we can't be.
dialog.translation:
Significa esto que estamos en
Japón? ...no creo.

dialog.english: Hey, Joe! What's "Japan"?

Matt is trying to call my place,
but we're not getting anywhere...
dialog.translation:
Matt está llamando a mi casa,
pero no parece que funcione...

dialog.english: Don't look so down, T.K...

It's not working at all...
we can't get through.
dialog.translation:
No funciona nada,
no hay línea.

dialog.english:
Even if we could connect, she's
probably out with the flower
arrangement class, not home...
dialog.translation:
Aunque funcionase, seguramente
esté en clase de arreglo floral,
no en casa...

dialog.english: What the heck's going on here...
Also, I'm getting hungry...

Yeah, we haven't had lunch...
okay, let's take a break!
dialog.translation:
Si, aún no hemos comido...
Vale, toca descanso!

dialog.english:
Does anyone have anything to eat?
Huh? Didn't this fall from the
sky?
dialog.translation:
Alguien tiene algo de comer?
Eh? 
No había caído esto del cielo?

dialog.english:
Huh? Didn't this fall from the
sky?
dialog.translation:
Eh? 
No había caído esto del cielo?

dialog.english: Looks like we've all got one.
What are these, anyway...?

In any case, we were talking about
food, weren't we?
dialog.translation:
Bueno, estábamos hablando
de comida, no?

dialog.english:
I have a laptop, a digital camera,
and a cell phone, but...
dialog.translation:
Tengo el portátil, una cámara,
un móvil, pero...

dialog.english:
None of them have worked since we
came here.
dialog.translation:
Ninguno funciona desde que
estamos aquí.

dialog.english:
All I have is this, my pocket
telescope!
dialog.translation:
Esto es todo lo que tengo, mi
catalejo!

dialog.english: I've got this! Look, candy!

Looks tasty! You're not from our
school, are you?
dialog.translation:
Qué rico! No eres de nuestro
colegio, no?

dialog.english:
Yeah! It's summer vacation, so I
came to visit Matt! Right?
dialog.translation:
Eso es! Estoy de vacaciones, así
que visito a Matt! Verdad?

dialog.english: Those two seem awfully close...
Maybe they're cousins?
What did you bring, Mimi?
Solid fuel, a fishing set...

You've got some pretty
full-fledged survival gear. That
could come in handy...
dialog.translation:
Caray, llevas un buen kit. Esto
podría sernos muy útil...

dialog.english:
Looks like these phones really
don't work at all. Huh? There's 
a sound in the distance...
dialog.translation:
Parece que estos teléfonos no
sirven para nada. Eh? Qué es
ese sonido a lo lejos?

dialog.english: HRAAAAH!
It's coming for us!
Sheeeeeeeell!
Aaaaaaagh!
W-what's that?!

It's Shellmon! We're probably on
his territory!
dialog.translation:
Es Shellmon! Estamos dentro de
su territorio!

dialog.english: Sheeeeeeeell!
Gabumon!
Gh...! Over here, Shellmon!
Sheeeeeeeeeeeeeeell!
Tai!
It's too dangerous! Run!!
Taiiiiiiiiiii!!
He evolved, again!
He just...got so big!

Greymon...
Yeah! You can do it, Greymon!
Shelllll...
Tai!

Agumon! You're back to being
Agumon...

Why do they change back after
evolving another stage? This
has gotten even more puzzling...
dialog.translation:
Por qué vuelven a cambiar después
de digievolucionar? No entiendo
nada...

dialog.english:
Ah, those phone boxes are all
banged up...
dialog.translation:
Ala... nos hemos cargado los
teléfonos...

dialog.english:
Then there's no reason for us to
stick around here.
dialog.translation:
Pues ya no tiene sentido quedarse
por aquí.

dialog.english:
But the fact that there are phones
here means that there must be
humans who have installed them!
dialog.translation:
Pero si hay teléfonos... habrá
humanos que los hayan instalado!

dialog.english:
Shouldn't we search for those
humans?
dialog.translation: No deberíamos buscar a esa gente?

dialog.english: I agree!
All right! Then let's go!

Everyone, make sure you have your
bags with you!
dialog.translation:
Aseguráos todos de que no dejáis
nada atrás!

dialog.english: Let's head out!
Ack! There's another Digimon!

Tai, be careful! There's a lot
of scary Digimon in this world.
dialog.translation:
Tai, cuidado! Hay muchos Digimon
temibles en este mundo!

dialog.english:
I see...they always jump out at us
out of nowhere, it's really
hard...
dialog.translation:
Ya veo... se abalanzan de
repente. Es difícil...

dialog.english: What's wrong, Tai?
I'm worried about everyone else...
Let's head out!
Wait. It's dangerous to separate.
〜ＴＥＳＴ〜

The conversation that triggers
Mimi's Bonding Rank going up
occurs here.
dialog.translation:
La conversación que aumenta el
Rango de Afinidad de Mimi ocurre
aquí.

dialog.english: By the way, Tai!
Huh? What?

I found this back when we were
attacked by Kuwagamon.
dialog.translation:
Encontré esto cuando nos atacó
Kuwagamon.

dialog.english: Not bad! So what'd you get?
Ta-da! It's a DigiPiece!
A DigiPiece?

So these DigiPieces will make you
stronger?
dialog.translation:
Estos DigiPieces te hacen más
fuerte?

dialog.english:
Yep! So try collecting as many as
you can!
dialog.translation:
Si! 
Consigue todos los que puedas!

dialog.english:
We might end up being attacked by
more Digimon, so...
dialog.translation:
Podríamos ser atacados por
más Digimon, así que...

dialog.english:
Okay! We'll find all the
DigiPieces we can get!
dialog.translation:
Vale, busquemos todos los
DigiPieces que hay!

dialog.english: We're counting on you, Tai!

Seems like evolving makes them
change quite a bit.
dialog.translation:
Parece que digievolucionar les
hace cambiar.

dialog.english: So what do we do now?

I wonder if every Digimon can
evolve.
Who comes to collect the money?
dialog.translation: Quien viene a por el dinero?

dialog.english:
Even at a time like this, I'm
getting somewhat excited.
dialog.translation:
Incluso en momentos así,
resulta emocionante.

dialog.english:
Does electricity pass through
this?

If Palmon's a plant, does that
make Agumon a dinosaur?
dialog.translation:
Si Palmon es una planta... es
Agumon un dinosaurio?

dialog.english:
I wonder if we should call for
pizza delivery.

Let's hurry up and find some other
humans!
dialog.translation:
Démonos prisa y busquemos a más
humanos!

dialog.english:
Hm, it's not going through. Let's
try another number.
dialog.translation:
Hm, no funciona. Prueba otro
número.

dialog.english: I wanna evolve into a Patamon too!

Doesn't making phone calls get you
all excited?
dialog.translation:
No te hace ilusión hacer
llamadas?

dialog.english:
All right, let's head for the
ocean!
Hey, look over there!
Ah-ah-ah...What's up?
Look, Tai!
...A box?

I bet there's something good in
there! Like a material or an
item...
dialog.translation:
Seguro que hay algo ahí! Objetos,
materiales...

dialog.english:
Or maybe one of those "DigiPieces"
from earlier?

Yup! Like that! You're getting
good at this, Tai.
dialog.translation:
Eso es! Algo así! Se te da bien,
Tai!

dialog.english: Tai, what's wrong?
Ah, it's nothing.
Let's go somewhere else!

Should we? Well, let's go find the
others first.
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos? Bueno, busquemos
antes a los demás.
